verdict.rationale: First-party README explicitly lists AVX, AVX2, AVX512, and AMX support for x86 architectures as a core feature, directly matching the story. Community evidence corroborates strong CPU-based performance (e.g., multi-core CPU runs of large models), though most hands-on benchmarks cited focus on Apple Silicon rather than x86 AVX/AMX specifics. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks specifically validating AVX512/AMX speedups on x86 hardware.
